details.story: As a repository manager, I want to back up repository data and metadata on a schedule, so that data can be restored according to the Disaster Recovery Plan.
details.reason: Disaster recovery and high availability are mentioned but scheduled backup is not defined.

details.story: As a repoadmin, I want to test and perform failover to the secondary site, so that the repository remains available if the primary server fails.
details.reason: High availability and remote replication exist but failover testing and execution are missing.

details.story: As a collection curator, I want to export collection and item metadata for reuse, so that I can analyze or move data between systems.

details.story: As a visitor, I want to download files that are openly available under the item access permissions, so that I can access repository content.
details.reason: Access permissions and licenses are described but the actual download action is not defined.

hidden: As an OlderPerson, I want to have ALFRED on all my computers, tablets and phone.
As an OlderPerson, I want to have clear instructions and service after sales that guide me if I have trouble in using ALFRED.
As an OlderPerson, I want to receive visual support, especially when looking at a list, map or agenda.
As an OlderPerson, I want to be able to customize my preferences in the different functionalities of the solution.
As an OlderPerson, I want to have my data stored directly on the phone.
As an OlderPerson, I want to receive a wake up call from ALFRED in the morning checking on me if I am ok.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED for navigation.
As an OlderPerson, I want to receive support to have a taxi on time.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to see who is standing at my door and open the door.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to pick the phone sooner up when I am at home.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to watch movies.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to send messages.
As an OlderPerson, I want to have ALFRED to suggest healthy recipes.
As an OlderPerson, I want to have ALFRED to initiate questions, but it should be in the domains of my interest such as cinema, exhibitions, cooking.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to set up social groups of people with similar diseases.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to learn about art expositions or a museum.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to learn about all the social activities that are organized in my neighborhood.
As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to navigate to an event or concert and help me when I am lost.
As an OlderPerson, I want to help me to control my body weight.
As an OlderPerson, I want to see my vital parameters myself on the phone.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to have ALFRED to propose me games that require the combination of mental and physical exercise, such as opposing motion exercises of the arms and legs.

As a developer, I want to have the accounting to be as simple and clear as Possible.
As a developer, I want to have the API to be well defined and well documented.
As a developer, I want to have an easy way to define questions the user can ask and perform.
As a developer, I want to have my App to be granted access to several operating system features.
As a developer, I want to have an easy way to read data from health sensors the user is wearing.

suggestions: As an OlderPerson, I want to protect ALFRED with a voice or PIN authentication, so that only I or trusted people can use it.
As an OlderPerson, I want to see who currently has access to my personal and vital data, so that I can revoke access when needed.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to lock automatically after inactivity, so that my data is not exposed when the device is unattended.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to authenticate securely to ALFRED, so that only authorized caregivers can view health data.
As an OlderPerson, I want adjustable font size and high-contrast visual themes, so that I can read visual content with low vision.
As an OlderPerson, I want vibration or haptic feedback for alerts, so that I notice reminders even with hearing trouble.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to connect to my hearing aid via Bluetooth, so that speech is clearer.
As an OlderPerson, I want a simplified menu with large icons on ALFRED, so that I can navigate without confusion.
As an OlderPerson, I want a charging dock that is easy to place ALFRED on, so that I can charge without handling small cables.
As an OlderPerson, I want the wearable ALFRED device to be water-resistant, so that I can wear it during daily activities like washing hands.
As an OlderPerson, I want a printed quick-start guide with large text, so that I can learn basic functions without relying on a screen.
As an OlderPerson, I want to allow a trusted family member to help configure ALFRED remotely, so that I do not have to manage settings alone.
As an OlderPerson, I want a demo mode to practice using ALFRED, so that I can gain confidence before real use.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to transcribe incoming voice messages or voicemail into text, so that I can read them with hearing difficulties.
As an OlderPerson, I want to send voice messages to friends and family through ALFRED, so that I can communicate asynchronously.
As an OlderPerson, I want to have group video conversations with multiple family members, so that I can join family gatherings remotely.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to announce the name of incoming callers, so that I know who is calling without looking.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to read my daily agenda aloud each morning, so that I know the day's plan without reading.
As an OlderPerson, I want to create recurring reminders for weekly or daily activities, so that I do not have to set each occurrence manually.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to set or adjust medicine schedules for a patient remotely, so that reminders reflect the prescribed regimen.
As an OlderPerson, I want to confirm by voice that I have taken my medicine, so that ALFRED can log it for caregivers.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide weather information and clothing suggestions before I leave the house, so that I dress appropriately.
As a SocialCaregiver, I want ALFRED to show my schedule for multiple care recipients, so that I can prepare for each visit.
As an OlderPerson, I want to cancel an accidental emergency call with a clear voice command or button, so that I avoid false alarms.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to automatically call my emergency contacts if I do not respond to a check after an alert, so that help is called even if I cannot act.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive fall alerts with location and time, so that I can assess the urgency of the fall.
As an OlderPerson, I want to set a dedicated emergency contact list in ALFRED, so that the right people are contacted in an emergency.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to share my essential medical information with emergency responders, so that they can treat me appropriately.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to view historical trends of the patient's vital measurements, so that I can detect changes over time.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to alert me when my heart rate is unusually high or low, so that I can seek help early.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to set patient-specific vital sign thresholds, so that alerts match the patient's condition.
As an OlderPerson, I want to share my vital data with my family, so that they know I am okay.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want a single dashboard showing all recent vital measurements, so that I can quickly assess the patient's status.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to suggest seated exercises, so that I can stay active even with limited mobility.
As an OlderPerson, I want to adjust exercise intensity, so that I do not overexert myself.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want ALFRED to offer exercise plans tailored to the patient's health conditions, so that exercises are safe and beneficial.
As an OlderPerson, I want to earn progress badges for completing exercises and games, so that I stay motivated.
As an OlderPerson, I want to compare step counts or activity with friends, so that social motivation encourages me to stay active.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to remind me to play cognitive games regularly, so that I maintain cognitive health.
As an InformalCaregiver, I want to see the user's game and exercise results, so that I can understand their physical and cognitive state.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to control window blinds or curtains, so that I can adjust daylight without getting up.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to lock and unlock my door, so that I can let caregivers in safely.
As an OlderPerson, I want to create simple home automation rules, such as turning off lights at bedtime, so that I do not forget.
As an OlderPerson, I want real-time public transport delay alerts, so that I do not miss connections or wait unnecessarily.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to suggest accessible walking routes that avoid stairs and uneven paths, so that I can walk safely.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to guide me back home if I get lost, so that I can feel safe outside.
As an OlderPerson, I want to create a shopping list by voice, so that I do not forget items when shopping.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to reorder my usual groceries, so that I do not run out of essentials.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to confirm successful small payments, so that I know the transaction was completed.
As a developer, I want a search and category system in the ALFREDO marketplace, so that users can find my app.
As a developer, I want a dashboard showing app downloads, ratings, and reviews, so that I can improve my app.
As a developer, I want a sandbox environment to test my app with ALFRED features, so that I can develop safely without affecting real users.
As a developer, I want versioning support for app updates, so that users receive improvements without losing data.
As a developer, I want documentation and examples for the ALFRED API, so that I can integrate quickly with less trial and error.

suggestions: As an OlderPerson, I want to adjust the volume of ALFRED's speech, so that I can hear it comfortably in different environments.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to provide haptic or vibration feedback for notifications, so that I can receive alerts even with hearing trouble.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to display text subtitles for spoken information and calls, so that I can understand despite hearing difficulties.
As an OlderPerson, I want to change ALFRED's wake word or activation phrase, so that I can address it in my preferred name or language.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to support multiple languages or dialects, so that I can interact in my native language.
As an OlderPerson, I want a simple and accessible charging dock for the ALFRED device, so that I can charge it without fiddly cables.
As an OlderPerson, I want the ALFRED device to be water-resistant, so that I can wear it while washing my hands or in the rain.
As an OlderPerson, I want to locate my ALFRED device if I misplace it, so that I can find it quickly.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to automatically update its software, so that I do not need to handle updates manually.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want a dashboard that shows a patient's recent health measurements and alerts, so that I can monitor multiple clients efficiently.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive automatic alerts when a user's vital signs are outside safe ranges, so that I can intervene quickly.
As an OlderPerson, I want to set up my emergency contacts in ALFRED, so that help can be reached when needed.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to call my emergency contact with a spoken message if I am unable to speak, so that I can get help in a crisis.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to ask me to confirm before sending an emergency alert after a suspected fall, so that false alarms can be avoided.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to remind me to drink water regularly, so that I stay hydrated during the day.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to suggest healthy meal options based on my dietary needs, so that I can maintain a balanced diet.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to remind me about medication refills or prescription renewals, so that I do not run out of medicine.
As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive a summary of the patient's medication adherence over time, so that I can discuss it during visits.
As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to read out written documents or medicine labels, so that I can access printed information despite visual trouble.
As an OlderPerson, I want to increase the contrast and font size on ALFRED's screen, so that I can read visual content more easily.

details.story: As a user, I want to perform a keyword search across metadata and notes, so that I can discover relevant materials without knowing specific field values.
details.reason: Existing search stories cover language, subject, name role, and collection limits but not general keyword search.

details.story: As a user, I want to filter or sort search results by title, date, or relevance, so that I can navigate large result sets effectively.
details.reason: Search and browsing stories do not mention sorting or filtering of results.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to assign persistent identifiers to collections, objects, and components, so that citations remain stable over time.
details.reason: Notes mention identifiers but no story covers persistent identifier assignment.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to define and edit controlled vocabularies for names, subjects, languages, and place terms, so that metadata values are consistent.
details.reason: Existing stories use name, subject, and language values but no story supports vocabulary management.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to bulk import metadata and files from a spreadsheet or manifest, so that large collections can be loaded efficiently.
details.reason: No bulk loading story exists despite the need to describe many objects and files.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to export metadata for collections, objects, and components in standard formats such as MODS or EAD, so that records can be shared with aggregators or other systems.
details.reason: External descriptions are mentioned but no metadata export story is present.

details.story: As a user, I want to see a collection landing page with its description, subjects, and related objects, so that I can understand context before browsing contents.
details.reason: Browsing collections and listing relationships are covered, but a collection detail view is not specified.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to set an access restriction or embargo date on an object or component, so that access is automatically hidden until the date passes.
details.reason: Rights and policy stories track restrictions and expirations but do not cover setting embargo dates.

details.story: As a user, I want to request access to restricted objects or components, so that repository staff can review and grant access.
details.reason: Access restrictions are tracked but no patron request workflow is present.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to manage user accounts and assign roles, so that only authorized staff can perform restricted actions.
details.reason: S3 constrains access by staff and managers but account and role management is absent.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to view audit logs of who changed or accessed repository records, so that changes can be traced and reviewed.
details.reason: Many stories record changes but no audit trail story exists.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to set a representative thumbnail or preview image for a collection, object, or component, so that users can visually identify resources in browse and search results.
details.reason: No story covers visual representation of resources.

details.story: As a user, I want to view files in the browser or a media player, so that I can assess content without downloading it first.
details.reason: S45 helps users decide whether a file is too large to download but does not cover online preview.

details.story: As a user, I want to download selected files or entire objects, so that I can use them in my research.
details.reason: S45 mentions access to files to decide about download size but not the actual download workflow.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to relate an object to another object, so that researchers can find alternate versions or related works.
details.reason: Collection-to-collection relationships and component links exist, but object-to-object relationships are missing.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to register and manage rights holder records, so that copyright and contact details can be associated with objects.
details.reason: S69 tells users who the rights holder is but no story supports creating or maintaining rights holder information.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to configure automatic notifications for copyright or policy expiration, so that staff can review access in time.
details.reason: S68 and S74 know expiration dates but no notification mechanism is present.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to link name records to external authority sources such as VIAF or LCNAF, so that identities are disambiguated.
details.reason: S57 registers name records but no external authority linking is mentioned.

details.story: As a user, I want to browse resources by name, subject, or geographic place, so that I can explore without formulating a search.
details.reason: Browsing stories only cover collections, not other access points.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to specify the physical location or container for an object, so that originals can be found for access or digitization.
details.reason: No story captures physical location information.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to delete or suppress a collection, object, component, or file, so that obsolete or erroneous records are not visible to users.
details.reason: S79 records deletion events but no actual delete or suppress workflow is specified.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to move or copy components or files between objects, so that resources can be reorganized as needed.
details.reason: Existing stories describe structures and order but not reorganization actions.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to manage derivative files and associate them with master files, so that users get appropriate formats for access.
details.reason: Existing stories refer to master files and content files but not derivative file associations.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to enter a date or date range for a collection, object, or component, so that users can understand temporal coverage.
details.reason: Date is mentioned as a describable facet but no explicit date entry story exists.

details.story: As a user, I want to search by date range, so that I can limit results to a specific period.
details.reason: No date-based search story exists despite dates being core descriptive metadata.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to maintain metadata templates for collection, object, and component types, so that repository managers enter consistent descriptive metadata.
details.reason: No metadata schema or template management story is present.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to associate a license file or license text with an object or component, so that permitted acts are documented.
details.reason: S72 asks if copyrighted content has a license but no story covers attaching the license itself.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to record preservation actions such as file migration or format normalization, so that the history of digital preservation is complete.
details.reason: S44 and S77 track events but no explicit preservation action recording story is present.

details.story: As a user, I want to cite a collection, object, or component using a generated citation, so that I can reference it in publications.
details.reason: No citation generation story exists despite titles and identifiers being managed.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to duplicate an object or component record and its metadata, so that similar materials can be described more quickly.
details.reason: No copy or clone story exists for cataloging efficiency.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to configure the search fields and facets available to users, so that the interface matches the metadata model.
details.reason: Search stories assume fields and facets but no configuration story exists.

details.story: As a user, I want to see a breadcrumb trail and context for a component within its object and collection, so that I understand its position in the hierarchy.
details.reason: S27 shows component parts but no contextual navigation is specified.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to flag an object or component for review due to uncertain copyright or access status, so that curatorial staff can resolve issues.
details.reason: Rights status stories track status but do not include a review workflow.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to run reports on object, file, and event counts by repository, so that I can monitor system usage and preservation coverage.
details.reason: S1 and S39 know asset counts but no reporting story exists.

details.story: As a user, I want to get a permanent link to a collection, object, or component, so that I can share it with others.
details.reason: Stable access links are implied by access and citation needs but not stated.

details.story: As a repository manager, I want to attach supplementary files such as finding aids or inventories to a collection, so that users can access richer descriptions.
details.reason: S12 covers external descriptions but not local supplementary attachments.

details.story: As a DAMS manager, I want to validate uploaded files against expected checksums and formats before ingest, so that corrupted files are not stored.
details.reason: S42 and S65 monitor checksums after ingest but no pre-ingest validation story is present.

details.story: As a user, I want to save and organize discovered music and videos into personal collections, so that I can access relevant content again later.
details.reason: Discovery stories lack a persistence mechanism for user-found content.

details.story: As an admin, I want to review and correct automatically generated tags and metadata, so that search and filtering accuracy is maintained.
details.reason: Existing stories cover tag upload and prefiltering but not human correction of generated metadata.

details.story: As an admin, I want to detect duplicate or near-duplicate videos before ingestion, so that redundant content is reduced and processing effort is saved.
details.reason: Similarity features exist for users but no admin-side duplicate detection story is present.

details.story: As an admin, I want to automatically generate speech transcripts for ingested videos, so that content items become searchable by automatic speech recognition.
details.reason: User ASR search depends on transcripts but no transcript generation story exists.

details.story: As an admin, I want to review flagged copyright infringement cases and apply actions such as block or allow, so that only compliant content remains available.
details.reason: Automated copyright validation is covered but no manual review or resolution workflow is specified.

details.story: As an admin, I want to link news videos, topics, and articles into related story packages, so that users can explore a news event across multiple assets.
details.reason: News event recommendations and topic extraction imply packaging of related assets.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to aggregate volunteer annotations and compute consensus for a subject, so that final classifications are reliable.
details.reason: Stories mention annotations and prompts but no consensus calculation is covered.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess volunteer accuracy using known gold-standard subjects, so that unreliable annotations can be downweighted.
details.reason: There are stories about volunteer comments and annotations but none about measuring volunteer reliability.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to retire a subject when sufficient annotations or consensus are reached, so that volunteer effort is not wasted on redundant tasks.
details.reason: Existing stories detect when to prompt scientists but not when to stop volunteer annotation.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to search and filter Talk comments by subject, keyword, or sentiment, so that relevant volunteer feedback can be acted on efficiently.
details.reason: Interesting comments are detected but no story covers searching or filtering Talk comments.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to export aggregated annotations and computed features for further scientific analysis, so that researchers can use the results outside the platform.
details.reason: Many preclassification stories imply downstream scientific use but no export story exists.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect blurry or low-contrast images, so that only clear images are shown to volunteers.
details.reason: Existing prefiltering removes artefacts such as bright stars and read errors but not general image quality issues.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to count individual animals in Snapshot Serengeti images, so that population estimates are more precise.
details.reason: Existing Serengeti stories detect empty images, species, and attributes but not animal counts.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect and classify whale call types in audio files, so that volunteers can review preclassified call types.
details.reason: Existing audio stories group similar calls and count whales but do not classify call types.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to segment long audio recordings by acoustic events, so that volunteers can label isolated sounds more easily.
details.reason: Noise removal and call grouping are covered, but acoustic event segmentation is missing.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to align and correct timestamps of burst images in Snapshot Serengeti, so that image series reflect the true chronological order.
details.reason: Timestamp malfunction detection exists but not correction or alignment of image series.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect worm behaviors beyond egg laying, such as feeding or locomotion patterns, so that videos can be segmented for targeted annotation.
details.reason: Motion analysis and egg-laying detection are covered but other worm behaviors are not.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify Galaxy Zoo galaxy morphology types beyond low-level image features, so that volunteers start from a more accurate label.
details.reason: Only simple low-level preclassification is covered for Galaxy Zoo images.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect and mask cloud cover in satellite images, so that unusable areas are excluded from feature detection.
details.reason: Satellite feature detection and artefact prefiltering are covered but cloud cover masks are not.

details.story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend training tasks or tutorials to volunteers, so that they improve their annotation skills before difficult subjects.
details.reason: Stories cover interrupting or educating volunteers but not proactive training recommendations.
